_note: Captured by calling the route handler directly against a real PGlite test DB (src/app/api/v1/me/notification-prefs/route.contract.test.ts), for a learner with no notification_prefs row and no 'notifications' settings_kv row. Confirms GET /api/v1/me/notification-prefs and PATCH /api/v1/me/notification-prefs return the payload FLAT - no { data } envelope - unlike almost every other endpoint in this API. The route previously used ok(), which added the envelope at runtime even though docs/API_ENDPOINTS.md (and the mobile app) were built against this flat shape; the route was fixed to match the documented contract instead of changing the contract.
